bcl { version "1.0" } # GENERATED by the console from the routing rules (Admin > Rules > Routing rules). # Do not edit by hand: the next change to a routing rule replaces it. module "custom_routing" { version "1" environment "production" decision_schema "custom" { effects [allow, deny] default allow strategy first_match } decision_table "custom" { default allow hit_policy first @for(r in rules) { row "${r.id}" { priority ${r.table_priority} when { all { provider.id == "${r.provider}" @if(r.account != "") { user.id == "${r.account}" }@if(r.tenant != "") { user.tenant == "${r.tenant}" }@if(r.countries != "") { message.country matches "^(${r.countries})$" }@if(r.recipients != "") { message.to matches "^(${r.recipients})$" }@if(r.templates != "") { message.template matches "^(${r.templates})$" }@if(r.recipient_prefix != "") { message.to matches "^${r.recipient_prefix}" }@if(r.recipient_pattern != "") { message.to matches "${r.recipient_pattern}" }@if(r.sender_pattern != "") { message.from matches "${r.sender_pattern}" }@if(r.content_words != "") { message.text matches "(?i)(${r.content_words})" }@if(r.content_pattern != "") { message.text matches "${r.content_pattern}" }@if(r.types != "") { message.type matches "^(${r.types})$" }@if(r.min_segments > 0) { message.segments >= ${r.min_segments} }@if(r.max_segments > 0) { message.segments <= ${r.max_segments} } } } then { outcome { decision ${r.effect} reason "${r.reason}" attributes { tier "rule" priority ${r.score} exclusive ${r.exclusive} rule_id "${r.id}" } } } } } } }
